name: The Second Coming
overview: Scripture reveals that the Second Coming of Jesus Christ is a future, visible, and glorious event that will occur unexpectedly, known only to the Father (Matthew 24:36, 24:44). Jesus will return in the same manner He ascended into heaven, coming with clouds for all to see, including those who pierced Him, causing the earth to mourn (Acts 1:11; Revelation 1:7). Believers eagerly await this blessed hope, the glorious appearing of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ, who promises to come quickly (Titus 2:13; Revelation 22:20).
